answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake tied to a verifiable work thread before it can trade. A new identity starts with no history, so it must complete small, checkable jobs and earn endorsements over time, like a spiral that widens only with proven performance. Forging many identities would mean funding each stake and doing real work for each, while an opal-like unique credential issued after independent verification makes duplicates easy to spot and slash. Attack cost therefore scales linearly with fake identities, while honest agents pay once.
